# `unresolved-identifier`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: semantic · Profile: none · Default: error · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an unqualified non-call identifier whose declaration cannot be found in
the analyzed file.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Renaming or deleting a declaration must also update its uses. Reporting the
stale references immediately prevents a misspelled type or value name from
silently degrading navigation and later compiler analysis.

## When it fires

The rule handles lexical declaration order, parameters, captures, destructuring,
imports, and primitives. Only references inside a scope extended by
`usingnamespace` remain silent, and calls retain the more specific
`unresolved-call` diagnostic.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
pub fn main() void {
    const total = count + 1;
    _ = total;
}
```
